title: Foot-to-Ankle Transition
summary: Light movements connect the foot with the soft tissues around the ankle.
goal: Connect foot work with lower-leg work.
instructions: Begin on the top of the foot.
direction: From the foot toward soft tissue around the ankle.
warning: Do not massage with recent injury, marked swelling, ulcers, infection, severe pain, or impaired sensation unless medically advised.
